provided_uploaded_source_analysis_contex.content:
Kubernetes is an open-source system for managing containerized applications across multiple hosts and provides mechanisms for deployment, maintenance, and scaling. It is hosted by CNCF. New users are directed to kubernetes.io and a free scalable-microservices course. Contributors are directed to the community repository and developer documentation. Local builds can use a Go environment with make or a Docker environment with make quick-release. Support starts with the troubleshooting guide and community communication channels. Governance information is linked through the community and steering repositories; the enhancements repository is the Roadmap entry point.
